title: NanoVI samplesheet schema
description: Schema for the input samplesheet CSV

sample.errorMessage: Sample IDs must start with a letter or digit and may only use letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'
sample.description: Sample identifier (letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-', starting with a letter or digit; the same rule as directory mode)

fastq.errorMessage: The fastq column needs an existing FASTQ file whose path ends in .fastq, .fq, .fastq.gz or .fq.gz and has no spaces
fastq.description: FASTQ file (.fastq, .fq, .fastq.gz, .fq.gz): local absolute or relative to the launch directory, or a remote URL (s3://, gs://, az://, https://)
